title: Apple announces major performance improvements across its platforms, including up to 30% faster app launches and up to 80% faster AirDrop transfers (Ryan Christoffel/9to5Mac)
summary: Ryan Christoffel / 9to5Mac: Apple announces major performance improvements across its platforms, including up to 30% faster app launches and up to 80% faster AirDrop transfers — Today during its WWDC keynote, Apple introduced major performance improvements across its platforms, including iOS 27 for iPhone. Here are the details.
